name: BlePositionServer
description: BLE peripheral (GATT server) receiving position+heading updates from the Android companion app for the map/nav feature. Capability-gated by FREEINK_CAP_BLE_PERIPHERAL -- compiles the NimBLE server code only when enabled, otherwise links stub bodies and references no BLE code. NOTE: when enabling the cap, add 'h2zero/NimBLE-Arduino@^2.3.8' to the firmware's lib_deps (same convention as freeink-sdk's BleKeyboardHost). It is intentionally not declared here so disabled builds pull in zero BLE code.
keywords: ble, bluetooth, gatt, peripheral, map, gps, nimble
